arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Martinez argued the district neglected Miguel for twelve years.
Mr. Martinez claimed the district lied to his parents about progress.
Mr. Yang argued the side that brought the case followed the correct legal path.

Mr. Yang stated the side that brought the case settled the IDEA claim first. He then filed the ADA action for damages. He claimed he could not get those damages under the IDEA. Mr. Dvoretzky argued Congress channeled FAPE denial claims through IDEA procedures. He stated Congress wanted parents to use those specific procedures. He noted the default rule applies to post-settlement questions.
